head: Google AI Mode adds your Drive files, with Wallet and Gemini chats next
dek: Personal Intelligence in Google Search's AI Mode can now draw on your Docs, Sheets and PDFs in Google Drive, Google announced on 23 November. Linking your Gemini app chats can be set up now and starts working in the coming weeks, and read-only access to cards in Google Wallet is coming later.
details: Personal Intelligence already used Gmail, Calendar and Google Photos. The Gemini link covers chats, files, photos, audio, video and screens you shared with Gemini. With Wallet, AI Mode can only read card and account details; it can't move, manage or invest money. Google gives examples like planning a trip across several searches or checking which card earns more cash back; a Personalization icon under answers, coming soon, will show what it used.
where: AI Mode in Google Search; Drive now, Gemini chats in the coming weeks, Wallet with no date yet
means: If you link these, AI Mode can answer with your own files, past Gemini chats and card perks instead of starting from nothing.
todo: To see or change what AI Mode may use, open myactivity.google.com and go to the AI Mode apps settings; turn personal results off under Search personalization in Google's search settings.
thumb_words: GOOGLE AI MODE READS YOUR DRIVE
